recommendation.clear_lexical_reason: Do not ship unconditional leisure mappings. A separately reviewed finite possessive/leisure context can retain ordinary benefit; existing broad noun guard is not that policy.
recommendation.name_policy_limit: These title/nickname labels use exact-reference preservation. Reversible reading with original/flip controls may motivate another presentation judgment; do not collapse that disagreement into dictionary sense gold. Prefer a general explicit-title/name context hold if implemented and qualified; otherwise withhold affected new entries in this increment rather than claim title-safe coverage. Do not add word-specific case heuristics.
recommendation.figurative_policy: Do not automatically withhold heart attack or fresh air: reviewed English framing preserves these metaphors.
recommendation.unexercised_entries: An addition with no changed selected output receives no fresh positive semantic acceptance from this capture.
recommendation.remaining: No population accuracy, native-speaker certification, or activation recommendation for the uncorrected candidate.
